research.title: Missing-Value Handling for Equipment Failure Classification
bullets: Cleaned equipment maintenance records, standardized missing-value codes, and prepared equipment-level training and evaluation splits following the study protocol.
Implemented specified imputation and logistic regression baselines, comparing discrimination and calibration across missingness patterns using the prescribed evaluation procedure.

publications.title: Comparing Imputation Baselines for Equipment Failure Classification with Incomplete Maintenance Records

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded inventory discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items for supervisor review.
Maintained order paperwork, organized stockroom supplies, and coordinated routine pickup schedules with staff handling outgoing orders.

projects.title: Regularized Regression for Residential Energy Demand
bullets: Implemented ordinary least squares and ridge regression baselines for residential energy demand using weather variables and calendar indicators.
Applied training-set standardization and chronological validation splits, then examined residual patterns across seasons and compared held-out prediction errors.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Baselines for Customer Segmentation
bullets: Implemented a customer segmentation baseline using scikit-learn Gaussian mixtures on standardized purchase frequency, spending, and recency features.
Compared covariance assumptions using information criteria and inspected cluster assignments to document sensitivity to initialization and feature scaling.
